scope: Existing fit_train + utility_train only. No heldout images/predictions used. Four classes; local GRDH source subset, not full OSS2.
geography: Reused 20261116 nearest-anchor water-area proxies, <=150km; conservative <=75km and second-nearest gap>=10km. Not official port labels.
bootstrap: 2000 within-group vessel resamples; exploratory selected extrema; CI does not account for product clustering or selection.
prediction_cache: Existing m1_coverage initial_source, source-side descriptive evidence, not unseen-port performance
